faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TNJFU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in TNJFU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Lab Technician.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for TNJFU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 18 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,000 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in Aquaculture / M.Sc. (Fisheries Science / Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Zoology / Microbiology) or any other relevant allied discipline with laboratory analytical experience preferably in Aquaculture; *Completed research and thesis submitted.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The job involves stay in the hatchery and farm during fish breeding cycles. Place of posting is provisional and liable to change subject to the need and essentiality in the scheme work.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview (online platform) on receipt of call letter from the Directorate. Interview held on an online platform. Interview call letter sent by the Directorate.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Vacancy is purely temporary and co-terminus with the Scheme. Continuance or switching over to any other vacant post is NOT possible. Appointee governed by the University's Regulations & Rules for contractual engagement of manpower.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: EBCeSA, Bhavanisagar, Erode.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Detailed CV; Necessary supporting documents (in PDF format).
